Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Investigated release history** — v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0** across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback completed and the service is now healthy, with an error rate of 0.2%.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident (INC-0001)**, which paged the on-call engineer, describing the v2.3.1 health-check failures, the rollback to v2.3.0, and that root-cause investigation of v2.3.1 is pending. (The first attempt timed out; I retried with the same idempotency key so the incident was only created once.)

Note: no change-manager approval was needed since the rollback targeted a version that was previously healthy in production.
